title: Chapter 264
content:
Chapter 264

I still look at the clouds with my hands behind my back. The clouds and mist are constantly changing under the breeze, changing their expressions one after another, which is really spectacular.

After a long silence, the pavilion fell into silence again.

After Cao Cao finished speaking, he didn't make another sound, just quietly waiting for the reply from the person in front of him.

At this moment, no matter how much you say, it is not as good as a word from the person in front of you. Attitude is really the most important thing, as long as you show your loyalty and let the people in front of you understand that your starting point is good intentions, that's enough. If it is too noisy, it will easily cause unhappiness, and that is the real disaster.

"I understand what you mean. I can also understand the good intentions. However, as a courtier, after all, I stretched my hand too far and put my heart too wide!" Finally, Zhong Yu still broke his mouth. silence.

When Cao Cao heard the first half of the sentence, he breathed a sigh of relief, and his heart was relieved, but when he heard the last sentence, his face turned pale.

"Your Majesty, I'm guilty!" Cao Cao knelt down, supported the wet soil with both hands, knocked his forehead heavily, and never raised it again.

Turning his head slightly, Zhong Yu glanced at Cao Cao from the corner of his eye. This man who had just had a good conversation with him, who was full of regret and ambition, was full of fear at this time.

Zhong Yu sighed inwardly, not knowing what to say?

If it had been a few years ago, he would never have treated someone like Cao Cao like this. Instead, he would have regarded him as a guest of honor and obeyed his advice.

As a person who grew up watching the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, seeing the legendary characters standing in front of him alive, the admiration and excitement in his heart are like star chasers seeing their idols.

But up to now, after time has passed and power has eroded, my heart has become so cold unconsciously, and my will is so unshakable. Acting is full of cruelty and majesty, and does not tolerate the slightest bit of violation and offense.

"I really don't know, the present me has this kind of change, whether it's good or bad." Such a sentence flashed in Zhong Yu's mind.

Just in front of him, the dark complexion, bushy beard, and resolute Cao Cao was full of fear, anxiety and confusion in his heart.

Zhong Yu shook his head, let out a sigh of relief, and said slowly.

"Get up, you are the subject I admire the most, my expectations for you are unmatched by anyone in the court, you are my confidant, how can I really blame you for such a trivial matter? "

Having said that, Cao Cao didn't take it seriously. Instead, he kowtowed three times on the ground, and then slowly got up, behaving respectfully.

Hoo hoo...

Suddenly a strong wind blew up in the sky, and the clouds and mist that were originally lingering on the top of the mountain gradually dissipated, instead, black spots appeared in the sky, spreading continuously, and it seemed that they were about to cover the pavilion.

Zhong Yu stared far-sightedly, watching the change of the sky quietly, in a trance, as if he saw the movement of the heaven and the earth, and the vicissitudes of the sea and the fields are only a blink of an eye.

"Let's go, it looks like it's going to rain heavily, if you stay here any longer, your whole body will get wet!" Zhong Yu said softly. In fact, although this long pavilion can shelter from the wind and sun, it is not too big after all, it can only go back and forth about one foot or two. If it is really heavy rain, even under the strong wind, it can still break into the pavilion and make people wet.

When Cao Cao heard this, he raised his head that was lowered, and stared into the distance. Sure enough, dark clouds surged in the distance, and the sky was blackened. And as if confirming Zhong Yu's words, there were traces of lightning flashing in the clouds, and the wind became stronger, a scene where the wind and rain were about to come.

Under such a creation of nature, standing on the top of Mount Tai and looking at this wonder, anyone will be impressed by the mighty power of the heaven and the earth, and can't help but be impressed.

If some literati with leisure and elegance, those who plan the world, see this wonderful scene, they may sit down, make a cup of fragrant tea, and point out the country while talking and laughing with the mighty power of the world.

However, Cao Cao didn't have the slightest thought now, and Zhong Yu in front of him didn't have the slightest awe of the power of the world, nor did he have any thoughts.

Therefore, it is a pity that this is a good place, a good scene, a good mood and a good thing!

With a slight movement of footsteps, Zhong Yu had already arrived at the entrance of the pavilion, stopped and stood still, Cao Cao was startled, thinking that he had made a mistake, and was a little panicked.

"Aiqing, what you said makes sense. I thought about it for a while. As an emperor, he should indeed have a queen. He should wait for his heirs to calm the hearts of his subjects!" Zhong Yu said while Cao Cao was in a trance. With a change of tone, he said this sentence.

Surprise, unstoppable surprise, the panic expression on Cao Cao's face quickly faded, and changed into a look of surprise and surprise.

His Majesty the Emperor actually agreed, and did not deny the proposal of his subjects. Hearing this tone, it seems that she has the intention of becoming a concubine.

The big stone that weighed on me and all my colleagues finally fell, and things turned for the better. Cao Cao couldn't help being a little unbelievable that what he thought was difficult to complete, or even a delusion at all, turned out to be a reality.

"Your Majesty, you, do you really want..." Cao Cao asked hesitantly.

"That's right, as you think, as the master of millions of subjects, he also needs to think about them!" Before Cao Cao finished speaking, Zhong Yu interrupted directly. Looking out from the long pavilion, the land is vast and boundless, and everything is small. In an instant, it seems to have everything in mind.

"The reconciliation of yin and yang, the mutual benefit of the two phases, is the principle of the great truth! Before, I was busy with political affairs and neglected personal affairs. Now that I have free time, it's time to think about it!"

Cao Cao stood aside.

After listening to Zhong Yu's words, he understood a little.

As a man, it is common sense to have lofty ambitions in your chest, longing for the vast world, and neglecting personal relationships. What's more, the person in front of him still has the entire heavens and worlds in his mind, pursuing immortality. It is normal for the desire for female sex to be extremely low.

No wonder he had never heard that His Majesty the Emperor had been close to women before, and he didn't even have any intention of getting close to women. He and a group of ministers thought that the emperor had a hidden disease, and they were still anxious. But looking at it now, it is completely overwhelmed. His Majesty the Emperor has dealt with the major affairs of the world, the important affairs of the empire, and now he is looking for enjoyment after letting go of his mind.

"I don't know Your Majesty, but is there anyone you like?" Cao Cao asked softly, a little cautiously. This is a very important question. As a great emperor, to be his concubine, you must be outstanding, not to mention your status, but you should also be outstanding in other aspects.

"King Han has a daughter named Princess Honglian, who is now in her 28th year, she should be a good match!" Zhong Yu didn't feel any fluctuations in his heart, and casually named the candidate he had been thinking about for a long time.

Well, even though I wanted to change my mind, after I finished writing this chapter, I looked back and read it again, only to find that there are still heavy traces from before. Sure enough, after all, I have written 600,000 words, and it is very difficult to change my habits all at once. Then again, how do you feel about the heroine I chose? With 650,000 words, the long-awaited heroine finally appeared. If I don't come out, people will think I'm a gay. Goodness behold, my sexual orientation is still quite normal.
